    Translation

Muslim authentically reports from him that the Messenger of God informed him of what had happened and what would happen until the Hour. His father was also a Companion, martyred at Uḥud. Ḥudhayfa died at the beginning of ʿAlī's caliphate, in 36 AH. [The Six.]

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 1156, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 154
